source_text: Ἔγραψά ⸀τι τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ· ἀλλ’ ὁ φιλοπρωτεύων αὐτῶν Διοτρέφης οὐκ ἐπιδέχεται ἡμᾶς.
english_snapshot: I wrote something to the church[a], but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them[b], does not receive us.

signals.text: Or 'I wrote a brief note to the church.' The Greek text has an indefinite expression ('I wrote something'), and some manuscripts expand the wording.
